summary: Land acquisition lapse under Section 24(2) of 2013 Act; constitutional bench precedent (Indore Development Authority v. Manoharlal) overruling Pune Municipal Corporation; possession taken sustains acquisition; compensation deposit not mandatory for non-lapse; highway project (Bharatmala Pariyojana) public interest; High Court error in applying pre-overruling interpretation.
legal_provisions_cited: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 s.24(2)
Indore Development Authority v. Manoharlal (2020) 8 SCC 129
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; acquisition upheld as valid.
